وُلُودِيَّةٌ , (IAar, L, K,) an inf. n. which has no verb, (Th, L,) and وَلُودِيَّةٌ (K) and وَلِيدِيَّةٌ, which, accord. to Th, is the original form, and ↓ وَلَادَةٌ , (L,) Infancy: (IAar, L, K:) boyhood; girlhood: the state of a وَلِيد or وَلِيدَة. (L.) Ex. فَعَلَ ذٰلِكَ فِى وُلُودِيَّتِهِ, and وَلُودِيَّتِهِ, He did that in his infancy: (El-Basáïr:) and فِى وَلِيدِيَّتِهِ when he was a وَلِيد. (L.) ―
-b2- وُلُودِيَّةٌ (L, K) and وَلُودِيَّةٌ (L) Rudeness; coarseness; hardness; churlishness; deficiency in gentleness, (L, K,) and in knowledge of affairs: (L:) illiterateness. (L.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
